reason: My order book is full for months and my office help picks up the phone anyway; the few calls that hit the mailbox I listen to in the van at lunch. I don't need more enquiries, I need fewer, so 149 a month to catch calls I can't take on anyway makes no sense.
objection: I don't want anyone fiddling with my phone setup or forwarding, and a brand-new outfit with no customers sending texts to my customers in my name, that worries me.
would_change_my_mind: If my office help left and nobody was answering the phone anymore, and a few trade colleagues I know had it running for a year without trouble.
